2607.01916.title: ContextSniper: AntTrail's Token-Efficient Code Memory for Repository-Level Program Repair
2607.01916.paper_summary: Large language model agents can repair real repository issues, but they often spend large context budgets on whole-file reads, broad searches, and long terminal outputs where useful evidence is mixed with irrelevant code and logs. This paper presents ContextSniper, AntTrail's token-efficient code memory layer for repository-level program repair. As the coding specialization of AntTrail's broader agent memory engine, ContextSniper implements the Sniper feature for precision evidence selection: it retrieves candidate code and runtime evidence, ranks it with hybrid retrieval signals, filters long outputs through an intention-aware context gate, and returns compact evidence packets while preserving recoverable source context outside the prompt. We evaluate ContextSniper on SWE-bench Lite with OpenClaw and Claude Code, using 50 task runs per host-agent condition. ContextSniper reduces total token use by 51.5% and logged cost by 36.4% for OpenClaw, and reduces total token use by 38.9% and estimated cost by 27.3% for Claude Code. Submitted-resolution rates decrease slightly, from 26.0% to 24.0% for OpenClaw and from 32.0% to 30.0% for Claude Code. ContextSniper's pilot testing scripts are open-sourced at https://github.com/Calluking/ContextSniper
2607.01916.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理可以修復真實的倉庫問題，但它們經常在整個文件讀取、廣泛搜索和長終端輸出上花費大量上下文預算，其中有用的證據與不相關的代碼和日誌混合在一起。本文介紹了ContextSniper，AntTrail的代碼記憶層，旨在提高倉庫級程序修復的令牌效率。作為AntTrail更廣泛的代理記憶引擎的編碼專業化，ContextSniper實現了Sniper功能，用於精確的證據選擇：它檢索候選代碼和運行時證據，使用混合檢索信號對其進行排名，通過意圖感知上下文閘過濾長輸出，並返回緊湊的證據包，同時保留提示外可恢復的源上下文。我們在SWE-bench Lite上使用OpenClaw和Claude Code對ContextSniper進行評估，每個主機代理條件下執行50次任務。ContextSniper將OpenClaw的總令牌使用量減少了51.5%，登記成本減少了36.4%；對於Claude Code，總令牌使用量減少了38.9%，估算成本減少了27.3%。提交解析率略有下降，OpenClaw從26.0%降至24.0%，Claude Code從32.0%降至30.0%。ContextSniper的試點測試腳本已在https://github.com/Calluking/ContextSniper開源。
